matches.description: Given a polynomial p and zero or more summands q_1, ..., q_r, check that p = q_1^2 + ... + q_r^2 by exact coefficient identity over QQ (the empty sum is zero). This is the trust-critical boundary: a floating comparison or solver status is not a mathematical certificate.
matches.title: Check a rational sum-of-squares decomposition by exact coefficient identity

matches.description: Given a polynomial p, monomial basis z, and symmetric rational matrix Q, check that p = z^T Q z with Q symmetric and PSD by exact rational arithmetic. This proves nonnegativity without floating eigenvalue computation.
matches.title: Check a rational Gram certificate for sum-of-squares

matches.description: Check whether two Latin squares of the same order are orthogonal, i.e., all ordered pairs of entries are distinct.
matches.title: Check orthogonality of two Latin squares
